Cadre 2.2.0 makes canonical state and its human-facing projection one atomic
review unit, completes the strict three-tool MCP v1 migration, and adds native
workflow discovery to both Codex and Claude Code. It also hardens async jobs,
parallel worktrees, project-skill reads, and LSP/DAP configuration while
removing obsolete runtime and compatibility layers.

## Highlights

- **Atomic document review.** Canonical JSON/JSONL and generated Markdown are
  frozen, reviewed, validated, committed, repaired, and rolled back as one
  pair. Durable approval sessions bind every stage to reviewed hashes and
  reject drift before execution.
- **Strict MCP v1 boundary.** `cadre_workflow`, `cadre_action`, and
  `cadre_read` are the only public tools. Nested requests, exact typed
  continuations, initialize/initialized lifecycle handling, and one validated
  resource registry replace retired aliases and forwarding shims.
- **Native command discovery.** Codex exposes `$cadre:<workflow>` and Claude
  Code exposes `/cadre:<workflow>` for all 19 workflows: `setup`, `newtrack`,
  `implement`, `debug`, `status`, `validate`, `flag`, `revise`, `review`,
  `ship`, `land`, `handoff`, `archive`, `release`, `refresh`, `revert`,
  `formula`, `artifacts`, and `skill`. Neither client installs a redundant
  `$cadre:cadre` or `/cadre:cadre` umbrella.
- **Parallel and job correctness.** Workers receive exact finish and recovery
  callbacks; canonical tasks complete before cleanup; unsafe merge state fails
  closed; persisted jobs become explicit interrupted failures after restart.
  Unconfigured monorepos now resolve an existing local or remote default branch
  instead of assuming `main`.
- **Safer project integration.** Capability-bound project-skill reads reject
  changed content, unsafe links, binary data, and path escapes. LSP and DAP
  configs use confined project namespaces, secure reads, atomic writes,
  configured adapters, and contained breakpoint paths.
- **Smaller package and codebase.** The job-runner and LSP-daemon modes remain
  embedded in `cadre-mcp`, while duplicate executables, flat MCP shims, dead
  source barrels/adapters, old migration scripts, package-layout fallbacks,
  and embedded maintainer contracts are removed.

## Compared with 2.1.0

| Area | 2.1.0 | 2.2.0 |
|---|---|---|
| Target review | Active stage materialized incrementally | Complete deterministic diff is frozen and visible on the first review call |
| Canonical documents | Canonical and projection handling could diverge | Registered canonical/projection pairs are atomic and hash-bound |
| Approval state | Review state was not a durable resumable session | Ignored sessions resume, cancel, detect drift, and emit compact completion evidence |
| Client discovery | Generic activation surface | 19 explicit workflows in both Codex and Claude Code, with no umbrella entry |
| MCP compatibility | Some internal aliases and forwarding layers remained | Nested three-tool contract enforced end to end |
| Resources | Fixed and parameterized resources shared looser routing | One typed registry validates fixed resources, templates, URIs, and queries |
| Parallel/jobs | More state inferred during recovery and cleanup | Progress follows observed canonical, branch, worktree, merge, and persisted job state |
| Package | 10 files; 1,936,959 bytes unpacked | 8 files; 1,916,503 bytes unpacked, a 20,456-byte reduction |
| Harness verification | 114 test cases | 148 test cases plus the team-scale simulation and documentation pipeline |

## Upgrade and compatibility notes

```bash
npm install -g cadre-ai@2.2.0
cadre install
cadre install --check
```

- Restart Codex or open a new task before using `$cadre:`. In Claude Code, run
  `/reload-plugins` or restart before using `/cadre:`.
- Replace saved `$cadre`, `$cadre:cadre`, or `/cadre:cadre` prompts with the
  explicit workflow entry for that client.
- Regenerate styleguide projections under `cadre/styleguides/`, review the
  diff, and remove the legacy `cadre/code_styleguides/` directory manually.
- Custom MCP clients must use nested requests, complete the
  initialize/initialized lifecycle, and invoke only exact returned
  continuations or documented typed callbacks.
- The removed standalone job-runner and LSP-daemon files were private
  implementation paths. Their private modes remain available through
  `cadre-mcp`.
- Custom LSP/DAP configuration must use `cadre/lsp.json|lsp-*.json` and
  `cadre/dap.json|dap-*.json`; inline DAP adapter commands are rejected.

## Verification

- Full workspace `pnpm check`, including 148 harness tests, the team-scale
  simulation, docs content validation, lint, typecheck, and production build.
- Native Codex and Claude Code installation and `--check` validation at 2.2.0,
  with both MCP configs targeting the packaged `cadre-mcp` runtime.
- Exact 19-entry command inventories in Codex and Claude Code, with Claude
  picker completion validated interactively.
- npm dry-run pack: 8 files, 407,919 bytes compressed, 1,916,503 bytes
  unpacked.
